_note: Casting for tools/voice/gen_gemini.py (Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS, model gemini-3.1-flash-tts-preview). voice = one of the 30 prebuilt voice names; direction = how the line should be performed, sent ahead of the text. Keep directions short and physical (age, energy, pace), never theatrical. Change a voice or direction and rerun: files are named by a hash of these settings.
_style: British English, rural northern accent. A villager in a small medieval mountain town talking to a traveller face to face. Natural, conversational, understated; not an announcer, not theatrical. No music or sound effects.

hale.direction: A gate warden in his fifties: gravelly, weary, dry, unhurried authority.

ivo.direction: A young guardsman, early twenties: casual, a little bored, friendly.

greta.direction: An innkeeper in her forties: warm, brisk, practical, busy but kind.

brandt.direction: A blacksmith in his forties: gruff, low, slow, few words, speaking over his work.

tobin.direction: A boy of about eleven: quick, eager, a bit cheeky.

marta.direction: A shopkeeper in her thirties: sharp, brisk, businesslike, dry humour.

aldous.direction: An old chapel brother: soft, breathy, gentle, slow, thoughtful.

maren.direction: A very old herbalist: slow, creaky, knowing, a little amused.

osric.direction: A hearty miller in his fifties: loud, cheerful, generous.

edda.direction: A farmer in her fifties: plain-spoken, steady, tired at the end of a day.

finn.direction: An old fisherman: quiet, murmuring, easy-going, long pauses.

lark.direction: A young travelling bard: light, wry, playful.

wren.direction: A hunter in her thirties: laconic, cool, clear, watchful.

rowan.direction: The village elder, very old: slow, grave, measured, kindly.

pip.direction: A small girl of about seven: bright, curious, talks fast.

hilda.direction: A weaver and mother in her thirties: soft, patient, a little worried.

bram.direction: A farmhand of about twenty: friendly, cheerful, simple.

narrator.direction: Even, quiet reading of a written note.

v.OM.direction: An old man of the town, past sixty: slow, dry, a little hoarse, sure of his opinions.

v.M1.direction: A tradesman in his late forties or fifties: steady, plain, a man speaking over his work.

v.M2.direction: A working man in his thirties or early forties: easy, direct, a little guarded with strangers.

v.YM.direction: A young man of about twenty: quick, unsure of himself, trying to sound older.

v.B.direction: A boy of about ten: bright, blunt, a little out of breath.

v.OW.direction: An old woman of the town, past sixty: unhurried, shrewd, dry, kindly underneath.

v.W1.direction: A woman of the town in her late forties or fifties: brisk, capable, has heard it all.

v.W2.direction: A woman in her thirties or early forties: warm, practical, quick, busy with her hands.

v.YW.direction: A young woman of about twenty: lively, wry, sure of herself.

v.G.direction: A girl of about twelve: clear, earnest, a little prim.
